supported_claims.claim: Composer focus is restored after successful exact-session reloads.
supported_claims.evidence: In agents-atomic-flow-trace.zip, call@10 is the only composer click. After the first and second Enter submissions, call@27 and call@44 wait successfully for the textarea to be document.activeElement; call@29 and call@46 then type through the page keyboard without another click. agents-unknown-before-confirmation.png also shows the restored textarea focus ring after the third submission.

supported_claims.claim: Two consecutive follow-up messages can be entered and submitted without re-focusing the composer.
supported_claims.evidence: The 5.36-second agents-atomic-flow.webm and its trace show Known failure delivery evidence and Atomic unknown delivery evidence typed and submitted with Enter after automatic focus restoration, with no intervening textarea click.

supported_claims.claim: The mobile primary-navigation hit areas now meet the asserted 44 CSS-pixel minimum.
supported_claims.evidence: Trace call@94 measures Agents at 62.953125 by 44 CSS pixels and Games at 61.5625 by 44 CSS pixels in the 390 by 844 viewport; agents-atomic-mobile.png shows the added vertical hit area without overlap or clipping.

supported_claims.claim: One exact unknown message transitions atomically from unknown at 1 attempt to submitted at 2 attempts.
supported_claims.evidence: agents-unknown-before-confirmation.png and agents-unknown-after-confirmation.png show the same Atomic unknown delivery evidence row and an unchanged history count of 3. The trace posts confirm_unknown to /agents/messages/m_e43f17/retry, and SQLite records unknown then submitted_to_terminal attempts for m_e43f17.

supported_claims.claim: Confirming the unknown message does not disable the unrelated failed-message retry.
supported_claims.evidence: The failed Retry same session control remains readable in both desktop captures and the mobile capture; trace calls call@65, call@84, and call@98 report the control enabled.

supported_claims.claim: The Agents page remains readable and responsive at 390 CSS pixels.
supported_claims.evidence: agents-atomic-mobile.png shows a single-column composer and history, wide primary controls, wrapped metadata, and no visible horizontal clipping.

gaps.gap: Real mobile soft-keyboard, safe-area, and visual-viewport behavior remain unverified.
gaps.missing_artifact_or_check: The mobile evidence is a headless Chromium viewport screenshot taken after the desktop interaction flow. It cannot show whether iOS Safari or Android Chrome preserves or reopens the soft keyboard after the reload-time focus restoration, keeps the textarea visible, and retains an ergonomic scroll position.
gaps.next_action: Run two consecutive Enter submissions on iOS Safari and Android Chrome with the soft keyboard visible, recording document.activeElement, visualViewport dimensions, and scroll position.

gaps.gap: Exact-target clarity with multiple similar live sessions is not exercised.
gaps.missing_artifact_or_check: All supplied artifacts contain one replyable agent, so the labels have not been challenged by two similar agent names or sessions.
gaps.next_action: Capture a two-agent fixture with similar labels and verify that the intended exact session is distinguishable before submission and in outbound history.

recommended_next_action: Run the restored-focus Enter loop once on iOS Safari and once on Android Chrome with the soft keyboard visible; if both retain a usable composer, promote this interaction review to passed.
summary: The final atomic browser evidence resolves both prior findings. Composer focus survives successful exact-session reloads strongly enough for two follow-up Enter submissions with no re-click, and the mobile Agents and Games links now have 44-pixel-high hit areas. Retry safety, exact-message reconciliation, state labels, and the 390-pixel responsive layout are coherent and readable. The review remains partial only because headless browser evidence cannot establish physical mobile soft-keyboard behavior or cross-platform focus parity, and the one-agent fixture does not exercise disambiguation between similar live sessions.
